The '''Model 300''',<ref name="TCWCG" /> also known as the '''Ubrikkian medlifter transport''',<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a model of [[medlifter troop transport]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]]. Requiring a crew of 2, it could carry up to four passengers in enclosed [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] "cacoons," tended by a [[Medic/Legends|field medic]] charged with ensuring that the wounded survived long enough to reach the operating table. The Model 300 was the medlifter most commonly used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> Ubrikkian Transports' sister company, [[Ubrikkian Steamworks]],<ref name="TNEGtD" /> originally designed its [[DD-13 medical assistant droid/Legends|DD-13 medical assistant droid]] to be used aboard Model 300s, but when the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] proved to be less useful,<ref name="TCWCG" /> and, thus, less profitable than anticipated, the company transferred its DD-13s to [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Units]].<ref name="TNEGtD" />
